touchpoints.name: Evento error
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Log WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' FACET name SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Evento sistema
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM PageView WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Cloud respuesta sistema servicios
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Panel aplicación servicio registro
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Span WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Entidad registro consulta error
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Log WHERE error IS true SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Rendimiento métrica
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' FACET name SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Métrica usuario entidad
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Entidad servicio
touchpoints.query: SELECT sum(errorCount) FROM Log WHERE duration > 0.5 FACET name SINCE 1 hour ago
